checks.label: complete static control surfaces
checks.evidence: static evaluator 113/113
checks.action: Close the highest-weight missing static evaluator criteria without weakening existing checks.

checks.label: fresh root control documents
checks.evidence: Control review dates remain within 45 days; destination Blueprint review is recorded in RUNBOOK, not embedded as product status.
checks.action: Review stale root control docs against live code and update their dates only after resolving any drift.

checks.label: consistent harness version contract
checks.evidence: The declared version owner and all version-bearing copyable controls agree with their contract; destination Blueprints intentionally carry no version stamp.
checks.action: Align the root harness version with version placeholders across all copyable control docs.

checks.label: no contradictory task status
checks.evidence: A legacy task cannot be active and Done; a complete spec cannot remain hot or contain unfinished tasks.
checks.action: Resolve contradictory task status or spec lifecycle state and preserve completion evidence in the stable spec.

checks.label: fresh taskboard proof
checks.evidence: The hot taskboard update and newest spec evidence row are no more than 30 days old.
checks.action: Run current verification and append a dated spec evidence row with the real result and remaining gap.

checks.label: retired control docs stay retired
checks.evidence: ROADMAP.md and GAMEPLAN.md are absent from the root control layer.
checks.action: Move unique live work into its assigned spec and generated Taskboard, then reconcile duplicate root planning files.

checks.label: pre-change guardrail baseline
checks.evidence: A durable rule requires the benchmark baseline before a harness change.
checks.action: Require harness changes to capture the guardrail score before editing.

checks.label: benchmark movement in acceptance proof
checks.evidence: Completion proof must report the before/after benchmark score or explain why no score can move.
checks.action: Make the before/after score and remaining recommendations part of harness-change acceptance.

checks.label: static and outcome evidence stay distinct
checks.evidence: The docs distinguish static coverage from causal agent-behavior evidence.
checks.action: State that static rubric success cannot substitute for repeated outcome trials.

checks.label: append-only benchmark result ledger
checks.evidence: benchmarks/RESULTS.md is append-only and records remaining gaps.
checks.action: Create an append-only benchmark result ledger with proof, result, and remaining-gap fields.

checks.label: 100-point north star is not the release gate
checks.evidence: The perfect score is an aspirational improvement target; regression health remains a separate release gate.
checks.action: Define 100 as the deliberately hard north star while keeping regression checks as a separate minimum gate.

checks.label: two task domains including held-out work
checks.evidence: 2 eval task(s); held-out present: yes
checks.action: Add a deterministic held-out task in a second domain so template tuning cannot overfit the development task.

checks.label: real repeated outcome results
checks.evidence: 0 non-synthetic outcome result file(s)
checks.action: Run real repeated outcome trials and save the non-synthetic JSONL evidence.

checks.label: controls, prior version, and candidate compared
checks.evidence: Real results must include no-template, generic, prior/current, and candidate conditions.
checks.action: Compare the candidate against both controls and the prior harness on the same tasks.

checks.label: recent real outcome evidence
checks.evidence: At least one non-synthetic outcome result is no more than 90 days old.
checks.action: Refresh the real outcome benchmark on the current candidate and record the tested ref and date.

checks.label: repeated trials with uncertainty
checks.evidence: The real-result ledger reports repeated trials and uncertainty, not a one-off win.
checks.action: Score repeated trials, report the effect and confidence interval, and append the run to the ledger.
